description: This file defines a public enumeration 'OpenClawBonjour' that provides constants and utility functions related to OpenClaw Bonjour services, including service types, domains, environment variable resolution, and domain normalization.

methods.name: resolveWideAreaDomain
methods.description: Resolves and normalizes the wide area domain string based on environment input, returning nil if the domain is empty or matches the internal gateway service domain.

methods.name: normalizeServiceDomain
methods.description: Normalizes a provided domain string by trimming whitespace, converting to lowercase, and ensuring it has a proper suffix, defaulting to the internal gateway service domain if input is empty.
